2: Given are the numbers $a=-\frac{1}{27}$, $b=\log_{1/4}64$, $c=\log_{1/3}27$. The product $abc$ equals: A. $-9$ B. $-\frac13$ C. $\frac13$ D. $3$
3: An amount of 1000 PLN was deposited in a bank for a one-year term with 4% annual interest. After the term ends, a 19% tax is deducted from the accrued interest. 4: The equality $\dfrac{m}{5-\sqrt5}=\dfrac{5+\sqrt5}{5}$ holds for: A. $m=5$ B. $m=4$ C. $m=1$ D. $m=-5$
6: The sum of all roots of the equation $(x+3)(x+7)(x-11)=0$ equals: A. $-1$ B. $21$ C. $1$ D. $-21$
7: The equation $\dfrac{x-1}{x+1}=x-1$: A. has exactly one solution: $x=1$. B. has exactly one solution: $x=0$. C. has exactly one solution: $x=-1$. D. has exactly two solutions: $x=0$, $x=1$.
9: The graph of the linear function $f(x)=(m-1)x+3$ passes through the point $S=(5,-2)$. Then: A. $m=-1$ B. $m=0$ C. $m=1$ D. $m=2$
10: The linear function $f(x)=2x+b$ has the same zero as the linear function $g(x)=-3x+4$. It follows that: A. $b=4$ B. $b=-\frac32$ C. $b=-\frac83$ D. $b=\frac43$
11: The quadratic function is given by $f(x)=x^2+x+c$. If $f(3)=4$, then: A. $f(1)=-6$ B. $f(1)=0$ C. $f(1)=6$ D. $f(1)=18$
12: How many integers $x$ satisfy the inequality $\dfrac{2}{7}<\dfrac{x}{14}<\dfrac{4}{3}$? A. 14 B. 15 C. 16 D. 17
13: In an increasing geometric sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, the condition $a_4=3a_1$ holds. The ratio $q$ of this sequence equals: A. $q=\frac13$ B. $q=\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{3}}$ C. $q=\sqrt[3]{3}$ D. $q=3$
14: The figure shows a line through the origin and the point $P=(-4,5)$, forming angle $\alpha$ with the positive $x$-axis. 15: If $0^\circ<\alpha<90^\circ$ and $\tan\alpha=2\sin\alpha$, then: A. $\cos\alpha=\frac12$ B. $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt2}{2}$ C. $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$ D. $\cos\alpha=1$
16: The measure of an inscribed angle in a circle is $20^\circ$ less than the measure of the central angle subtended by the same arc. It follows that the inscribed angle measures: A. $5^\circ$ B. $10^\circ$ C. $20^\circ$ D. $30^\circ$
18: The line $l$ with equation $y=m^2x+3$ is parallel to the line $k$ with equation $y=(4m-4)x-3$. Then: A. $m=2$ B. $m=-2$ C. $m=-2-2\sqrt2$ D. $m=2+2\sqrt2$
19: The lines with equations $y=2mx-m^2-1$ and $y=4m^2x+m^2+1$ are perpendicular for: A. $m=-\frac12$ B. $m=\frac12$ C. $m=1$ D. $m=2$
20: Given are the points $M=(-2,1)$ and $N=(-1,3)$. Point $K$ is the midpoint of segment $MN$. The image of point $K$ under symmetry with respect to the origin of the coordinate system is the point: A. $K'=\left(2,-\frac32\right)$ B. $K'=\left(2,\frac32\right)$ C. $K'=\left(\frac32,2\right)$ D. $K'=\left(\frac32,-2\right)$
